newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P rates Orico Asset Funding Japan's notes AAA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Orico Asset Funding Japan's notes AAA.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Tuesday it had assigned its AAA rating to Orico Asset Funding Japan's four tranches of asset-backed fixed-rate notes.

The notes, worth about 30 billion yen in total, are the first example of securitisation of assets in the form of asset-backed bonds after "the law for the regulation of Business Relating to Specified Claims" was revised, it said.
The notes are backed by 35 billion yen worth of car loans the company purchased from Orient Corp, the rating agency added.
